reuse.why: Reuses applyWeekendRule, recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and dayFromDate, and threads holidays through the existing weekend rule, but the daily-skip decision is not folded into that rule.

duplication.why: The 'daily schedule: drop off-days instead of moving them' branch (isDailyWeekendSkip + isOffDay filter + oversized take) is re-implemented separately in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.

placement.why: Holiday/off-day logic correctly sits in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily-vs-move dispatch lives at each server call site rather than in the shared weekend definition, and frequency is smuggled into the rschedule data in rule-utils.

scope.why: Changes stay on the schedule date path across the four steps, plus a release note; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Three callers must each remember the daily special case, with ad-hoc look-ahead heuristics (count*7 + holidays*..., 7 + holidays, 3 + holidays padding) that are hard to reason about.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange branch around applyWeekendRule for daily schedules instead of the rule deciding skip vs move; schedule-template still applies its own skipWeekend ternary.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily skip filter is reshaped at each site (a `pick` closure in getNextDate, a filter/slice chain in getUpcomingDates, an early-return in a forEach in getDatesInRange) rather than shared.

abstraction_drift.where: holidays added to applyWeekendRule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend; daily-skip special case handled outside the helper in getNextDate (shared/schedules.ts), getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange (server/schedules/app.ts).
